CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  July 12, 2022

•  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

•  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Stanley Tsai
  Absent:  Nora Hernandez
  Staff Present: Vist Yang, Erin Joson

  CONSENT AGENDA

  All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design Review
  Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the Discussion
  Agenda.

  ITEM 1: MINUTES – June 28, 2022

  ITEM 2: 1412 Alhambra Road
  This is an application for a new fence for an existing single-family residence.

  MOTION:
  •  Daninger moved to approve the consent agenda as recommended.
  •  The second was by Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Hernandez

  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  ITEM 3: 2616 Essexfells Drive
  This is an application for an exterior deck and one-story addition to an existing single-family
  residence.

  RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

  1
 ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present.

Daninger clarified the roof condition on the west elevation.

MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to approve the application as submitted.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Hernandez

ITEM 4: 2424 West Main Street
This is an application for a new car wash building.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1.
All signage shall be under separate application; 2. The applicant shall work with DRB staff on the
materials/color palette prior to Planning Commission hearing; 3. Any required MWELO
documentation shall be provided at the time of Building Department plan check submittal; and 4.
All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to the Planning
Commission hearing.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present.

Udani agreed with staff comments regarding color palette highlighting that the yellow was too
bright.

Daninger agreed that the colors should be reconsidered and toned down.

MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1. All signage shall be under separate application;
  2. The applicant shall work with DRB staff on the materials/color palette
  prior to Planning Commission hearing;
  3. Any required MWELO documentation shall be provided at the time of
  Building Department plan check submittal; and
  4. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior
  to the Planning Commission hearing.
 •  The second was by Daninger.

  2
   •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Hernandez

 ADJOURNMENT:

 There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:50 P.M. to July 26, 2022.

 MOTION:
  •  Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:50 pm.
  •  Seconded by Tsai
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Hernandez

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 26th day of July, 2022.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect

  3
